phrase: A falta de pan, buenas son tortas
meaning: Half a loaf is better than none
example: "No hay café, pero hay té. A falta de pan, buenas son tortas." (There is no coffee, but there is tea. Half a loaf is better than none.)
"Dije que iría al gimnasio y, dicho y hecho, aquí estoy" (I said I would go to the gym and, said and done, here I am)
"Lleva un paraguas por si acaso llueve" (Take an umbrella just in case it rains)
"Me pidió ayuda y, dicho y hecho, fui a su casa" (He asked me for help and, no sooner said than done, I went to his house)
"A estas alturas, ya debería saber la verdad" (At this point, he should already know the truth)
"A la larga, estudiar mucho ayuda" (In the long run, studying a lot helps)
"A estas alturas, ya no quiero ir al cine" (At this point, I don't want to go to the cinema anymore)
"Dicho y hecho, compramos los boletos" (No sooner said than done, we bought the tickets)

meaning: to get one's act together / to power up
example: "Si queremos terminar el proyecto hoy, tenemos que ponernos las pilas." (If we want to finish the project today, we have to get our act together.)

meaning: to pull someone's leg / to tease
example: "No te pongas triste, él solo te está tomando el pelo." (Don't get sad, he is only pulling your leg.)
"El jefe decidió hacer la vista gorda esta vez." (The boss decided to turn a blind eye this time.)

meaning: To hit the nail on the head
example: "Tú diste en el clavo con la respuesta" (You hit the nail on the head with the answer)

meaning: For want of / In the absence of
example: "A falta de café, voy a beber té" (In the absence of coffee, I am going to drink tea)
"No debes dar por sentado su apoyo." (You shouldn't take their support for granted.)
"Este viaje es muy caro, pero vale la pena." (This trip is very expensive, but it is worth it.)
"A decir verdad, no me gusta nada la comida picante." (To tell the truth, I don't like spicy food at all.)
"La lluvia está al caer" (The rain is about to fall)
"Él dijo que iría a la tienda y, dicho y hecho, compró el pan" (He said he would go to the store and, no sooner said than done, he bought the bread)

meaning: To be daydreaming / To be distracted
example: "Mi hermano siempre está en las nubes cuando el maestro explica." (My brother is always daydreaming when the teacher explains.)
"Estábamos en ascuas mientras esperábamos los resultados del examen." (We were on tenterhooks while we waited for the exam results.)
"Leí el libro de cabo a rabo en un día." (I read the book from start to finish in one day.)

meaning: to be aware / to be up to date
example: "Necesito estar al tanto de las noticias." (I need to be aware of the news.)
"Echo de menos mi casa cuando viajo." (I miss my home when I travel.)

meaning: To lend a hand / To help out
example: "¿Me puedes echar una mano con estas cajas?" (Can you lend me a hand with these boxes?)

meaning: To be packed/full to the brim
example: "El concierto estaba de bote en bote; no podíamos movernos." (The concert was packed; we couldn't move.)

phrase: estar con la mosca detrás de la oreja
meaning: to be suspicious / to have a bee in one's bonnet
example: "Después de la llamada, me quedé con la mosca detrás de la oreja." (After the call, I was suspicious.)

meaning: at the end of the day / after all
example: "A fin de cuentas, lo importante es que estamos juntos." (At the end of the day, what's important is that we are together.)

meaning: to take a look / to glance
example: "Voy a echar un vistazo al menú antes de pedir." (I'm going to take a look at the menu before ordering.)

meaning: To be in a bad mood / Grumpy
example: "Mi jefe está de mala leche hoy, mejor no le pidas nada." (My boss is in a bad mood today, better not ask him for anything.)
"Siempre hago la cama antes de desayunar." (I always make the bed before breakfast.)

meaning: to be aware of / to be up to date with
example: "Necesito estar al tanto de las noticias importantes." (I need to be aware of the important news.)
"Esa pizza tiene muy buena pinta, ¿la probamos?" (That pizza looks very good, shall we try it?)

phrase: Darle la vuelta a la tortilla
meaning: To turn the tables / To turn a situation around
example: "El equipo estaba perdiendo, pero en el último minuto le dio la vuelta a la tortilla." (The team was losing, but in the last minute it turned the tables.)

meaning: to speak frankly / without mincing words
example: "Mi abuela siempre habla sin pelos en la lengua." (My grandmother always speaks frankly.)
